definitions.explanation: To move to a lower position or level. The intransitive form—something goes down by itself.

definitions.gloss: to drop, to fall, to decrease
definitions.explanation: For a value, temperature, or level to decrease.

definitions.gloss: to step back, to move back
definitions.explanation: To move backward or retreat from a position.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {下|さ}げる (transitive, to lower). Pattern: Xが{下|さ}がる (X goes down).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {下|さ}がっている = 'has gone down' or 'is low.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{気温|きおん}が{下|さ}がる (temperature drops)
・{値段|ねだん}が{下|さ}がる (price drops)
・{熱|ねつ}が{下|さ}がる (fever goes down)
・{後|うし}ろに{下|さ}がる (step back)
・{成績|せいせき}が{下|さ}がる (grades drop)

CONTRAST:
・{下|さ}がる (intransitive): X goes down
・{下|さ}げる (transitive): (someone) lowers X

OPPOSITE: {上|あ}がる (to go up, to rise)
